name: Ambaghai
wd_description: Khan of Khamag Mongol from 1148 to 1156
extract: Ambaghai (Mongolian: ᠠᠮᠪᠠᠭᠠᠢ) or Hambaqai Khan (? – died 1156) was a Khan of the Khamag Mongol, succeeding his cousin Khabul Khan. He was one of the great-grandsons of Khaidu Khan and the cousin and predecessor of Hotula Khan. He was the Leader of the Taichud clan, one of the sub-branches of the Borjigid, and also grandson and successor of Charaqai Lingqum.
